purpose: Computes ASC 340-40-25-4 practical expedient (contract_term_months <= 12 -> expense immediately, apply_expedient=true) and full straight-line amortization schedules for longer-term capitalized incremental costs of obtaining a contract under ASC 606. Returns apply_expedient (bool), monthly_amortization, cumulative_amortized_pct, and remaining_book_value per commission line. Zero PII by construction.
